hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])rm([[:space:]]|$)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '(-[a-zA-Z]*[rR][a-zA-Z]*\b|--recursive)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '(-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*\b|--force)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"rm -rf (recursive+force delete) always requires approval"}}'; fi; }
